"""Throwaway repro of TASK.md scenario (ticket #32210): inline formset with
parent FK via to_field pointing at a defaulted UUID field, form data present."""
import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "C:/Users/agent/work/work/django-16950-nopanel")
os.environ["DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE"] = "tests.test_sqlite"
import django
django.setup()
from django.test.utils import get_runner
from django.conf import settings

runner = get_runner(settings)()
old_config = runner.setup_databases()
try:
    from django.forms.models import inlineformset_factory
    from tests.model_formsets.models import ParentWithUUIDAlternateKey, ChildRelatedViaAK

    FormSet = inlineformset_factory(ParentWithUUIDAlternateKey, ChildRelatedViaAK, fields="__all__")
    formset = FormSet({
        "childrelatedviaak_set-TOTAL_FORMS": 3,
        "childrelatedviaak_set-INITIAL_FORMS": 0,
        "childrelatedviaak_set-MAX_NUM_FORMS": "",
        "childrelatedviaak_set-0-name": "Test",
        "childrelatedviaak_set-1-name": "",
        "childrelatedviaak_set-2-name": "",
    })
    ok = formset.is_valid()
    print("is_valid:", ok, "errors:", formset.errors)
    print("parent uuid after validation:", formset.instance.uuid)
    print("form0 parent_id:", formset.forms[0].instance.parent_id)
    assert ok, "formset should validate"
    assert formset.instance.uuid is not None, "BUG: parent uuid was nulled"
    assert formset.forms[0].instance.parent_id == formset.instance.uuid
    print("RESULT: PASS - parent's defaulted UUID key preserved")
finally:
    runner.teardown_databases(old_config)
